title: Quy trinh quay lai phien ban on dinh
body: Khi trien khai loi, doi van hanh dung rollout va quay lai phien ban on dinh gan nhat. Sau rollback, xac minh health check va ghi lai su co.

title: Search access scope contract
body: Search must enforce access scope before ranking candidates. Public queries can retrieve only public documents, while internal documents require an explicit internal scope.

title: Agent retrieval contract
body: The agent retrieval contract requires answers to cite only retrieved chunks. The agent must abstain when no authorized evidence matches the question.

title: Retrieval evaluation guide
body: Retrieval evaluation measures recall and reciprocal rank against governed relevance judgments. Evaluation also checks abstention accuracy and citation integrity.

title: Aurora acquisition budget
body: The confidential Aurora acquisition budget is forty million dollars. This document is restricted to the internal scope.

title: Incident review checklist
body: An incident review records the timeline, impact, contributing factors, and follow-up owners. The checklist supports operational learning after recovery.
